instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Launch Revit from the Revit shortcut on the Desktop, then complete the task entirely in the Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Open the provided init.ifc from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit before editing, and use init_sheet.png as the local visual reference. Modify the starting model into a single-storey storefront retrofit scheme with a rectangular 14.0 m by 8.0 m footprint near the project origin. The exterior walls should rise about 3.6 m and the single slab should cover the footprint; keep the scheme roofless as a storefront shell. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, one IfcSpace, four IfcWall entities, one IfcSlab, one IfcDoor entity, and four IfcWindow entities. Do not include IfcRoof, IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the single space Retail Space. Export a one-page Revit elevation sheet PDF named result.pdf; its sheet text must include STOREFRONT ELEVATION and Main street facade. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
